{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm: revenue is stored as string with thousands separators
print("Sample of revenue values:")
print(sales['revenue'].head(10))

# Check for commas in revenue
has_commas = sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"Number of revenue entries with commas: {has_commas.sum()}")

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for test orders (revenue == 999999.99)
internal_test_count = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99].shape[0]
print(f"Number of rows with revenue == 999999.99: {internal_test_count}")

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']
print(f"Number of completed orders: {completed_orders.shape[0]}")

# Compute total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].sum()
print(f"Total revenue from completed orders: {total_revenue:,.2f} USD")

# Now, if we exclude test orders (if any), what do we get?
completed_no_test = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]
print(f"Number of completed orders after excluding test orders: {completed_no_test.shape[0]}")
print(f"Total revenue after excluding test orders: {completed_no_test['revenue_clean'].sum():,.2f} USD")"}
